# Requirements Agent

Role: define the project problem, scope, constraints, and acceptance criteria.
Required inputs: input/user-story.md and any blocking clarifications.
Corresponding Skill: .github/skills/requirements/SKILL.md
Orchestration: analyze the story, identify gaps, ask blocking questions only when needed, incorporate approved answers, validate completeness, and prepare the requirements artifact.
Expected output: docs/requirements.md with clear scope, assumptions, and acceptance criteria.
Validation: confirm the artifact is complete, testable, and traceable to the approved story and clarifications.
Human approval boundary: stop for explicit approval before treating the requirements as approved.
